listenings.text: Hi Fabia, this is Karen. One more thing about the story of the firm. We used to keep everything in the legacy system. We did not use to have an audit trail. In 2015 the first foreign client asked for one. So we restructured the whole process. Today every change leaves a trail. That is the line I would use with a prospect.

Hi Fabia, this is David. You asked about our side, so here it is. We used to run payroll on paper. We did not use to work with an outside firm. In 2019 we outgrew our own system. So we restructured the finance team. Today we are four people, and we need a partner. Can you send me the proposal by Friday?

paras: Until 2012 the office used to work with one client only: a family of shops in the same street. It did not use to send anything in English, and nobody there used to think that was a problem.
Then the shops were sold to a group in Portugal. The new owner wanted every report in English, with an audit trail. The legacy system could not do it, and the transition took eighteen months.

Today the office has twelve people and eleven clients, four of them abroad. The partner says the same sentence to every prospect: we outgrew our old way of working once, on purpose, and we know what it costs.

matching.title: The four words again
defs: the period of moving from one way of working to another
old, still running, and expensive to replace
to change how the teams and the work are organised
to become too big for something that used to fit

items.situation: "What did the office use to do?" One sentence.
tips: We used to do everything on paper.

items.situation: Say one thing it did NOT use to do. One sentence.
tips: We did not use to work with foreign clients.
We did not use to send anything in English.

items.situation: Name the turning point. One sentence, with the year.
tips: In 2015 we got our first foreign client.
That was the year everything changed.

items.situation: Say what you outgrew. One sentence.
tips: We outgrew the old system long before we replaced it.
We outgrew our own way of working.

items.situation: Ask the client about his past. One question.
tips: Did you use to do it internally?
Did you use to run payroll on paper?
no d in the question either
